CREATE TABLE "user".one_id_user ( user_id UUID NOT NULL ,
-- OneID identifikatorlar pin VARCHAR(14), login VARCHAR(255), one_id_user_id BIGINT,
-- FIO lotin surname_latin VARCHAR(255), name_latin VARCHAR(255), patronymic_latin VARCHAR(255),
-- FIO kirill surname_cyr VARCHAR(255), name_cyr VARCHAR(255), patronymic_cyr VARCHAR(255),
-- FIO ingliz surname_en VARCHAR(255), name_en VARCHAR(255),
full_name VARCHAR(500),
-- Passport document VARCHAR(20), doc_num VARCHAR(50), issue_place VARCHAR(500), issue_place_id VARCHAR(50), issue_date DATE, end_date DATE,
-- Tug'ilgan joy birth_date VARCHAR(20), birth_place VARCHAR(500), birth_place_id VARCHAR(50), birth_country VARCHAR(255), birth_country_id VARCHAR(50),
-- Shaxsiy sex VARCHAR(10), nationality VARCHAR(255), nationality_id VARCHAR(50), citizenship VARCHAR(255), citizenship_id VARCHAR(50), live_status VARCHAR(50),
-- Kontakt email VARCHAR(255), phone VARCHAR(20),
-- Manzil cadastre VARCHAR(100), country_id VARCHAR(50), country VARCHAR(255), region_id VARCHAR(50), region VARCHAR(255), district_id VARCHAR(50), district VARCHAR(255), address VARCHAR(1000),
-- Boshqa photo TEXT, auth_method VARCHAR(50), valid VARCHAR(10), lang VARCHAR(10), is_active BOOLEAN, is_legal BOOLEAN,
created_date TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), last_modified_date TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now() );
